resources.string: Notepad is a simple, secure, and intuitive workspace designed to effortlessly capture your daily ideas, thoughts, and task lists. Your personal notes stay fully protected through robust Firebase Cloud Authentication and quick biometric login, supported by smooth progress indicators across the Login, Sign-Up, and Main screens to ensure a seamless navigation experience. You can easily organize entries using custom color palettes, perform instant searches, and quickly convert physical text into digital notes using the built-in OCR scanner. Furthermore, the newly added sharing system allows you to convert any note into a styled card image and share it directly with anyone on WhatsApp with a single click of the Share button.
"Capture your daily thoughts, ideas, and tasks instantly in one secure place."
Join us to keep your notes organized and safe.
